title: Faithful spatial PBS and BCBS(1.5) baseline protocol
note: This JSON was written after the formal runs completed. The method specification was fixed in code before execution; this file records those settings for reproducibility.
instances: generate_instance(density, 10000*density_idx + seed), density_idx = {low:0, medium:1, high:2}, seed = 0..49; identical to main_150_raw.csv

pbs.high_level: Depth-first search over the priority tree. Each conflict (i,j) on a shared interior voxel branches to (i>j) and (j>i); the lower-cost child is expanded first.
pbs.low_level: Same A* as the publish repo, congestion weight 0 (optimal for length + bend + vertical cost).
pbs.closure: Transitive closure of the priority partial order; cyclic children are pruned.
pbs.replan: Replan the changed agent and affected descendants in topological order, each avoiding the union of higher-priority agents' paths.

bcbs.high_level: Focal search with suboptimality factor w=1.5. OPEN ordered by sum-of-costs; FOCAL holds open nodes within w * min_open_cost, ordered by conflict count.
bcbs.low_level: Same A* as the publish repo, congestion weight 0 (optimal). Full ECBS would also use focal search at the low level; this variant does not.
bcbs.conflict: Shared interior voxel (path[1:-1]); endpoints are safe because foreign terminals are forbidden.
bcbs.branching: Forbid the conflicting voxel for one of the conflicting routes; deduplicate by constraint signature.

validation: validate_paths from routing_revision_solvers.py on every returned solution; recomputed cost checked against stored cost.
statistics: Exact two-sided McNemar per density against pbs_random, stage3_only, and proposed (main_150_raw.csv), Holm-corrected across densities within each comparator family. Paired bootstrap of mean physical-cost difference on jointly completed scenes (seed 20261104, 10000 resamples).
honest_disclosure: PBS completed 19/50 high-density scenes versus 9/50 for the proposed method (Holm-adj p=0.0059). This is an adverse result for the proposed congestion-guided repair and is reported as such.
